'''Llanic''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Karthakk sector/Legends|Karthakk sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

==Description==
Located at the intersection of the [[Llanic Spice Run/Legends|Llanic Spice Run]] and the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]], Llanic was perfectly situated to take advantage of the Outer Rim's [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] traffic. Due to the high volume of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] and other illicit cargo passing through the system, Llanic was widely considered a [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]].<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] were frequented by [[Starship/Legends|starships]] from far away planets like [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]], and [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Novice smugglers often got their start on Llanic. They could often find easy work, picking up short hauls at some of the planet's infamous [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
A [[Battle of the Llanic system|battle]] occurred in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Llanic during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] constructed a secret [[Space station/Legends|space station]], where was developed a new biological weapon, the [[Ziroxin-12/Legends|Ziroxin-12]]. However the Republic discovered the Sith's plans and sent the [[Coruscant Aegis]] to spearhead assault on the station.<ref name="LSS">{{TORcite|type=space|Llanic Station Strike}}</ref>

[[File:Battle_of_the_Llanic_system.png|thumb|left|180px|[[Battle of the Llanic system|Llanic Station Strike]].]]

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Llanic was the site of a [[Battle of Llanic|battle]] as part of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] besieged [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] holdings on the planet.<ref name="TEA" />

Though a smuggler's haven, the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] was known to patrol Llanic, often launching raids against known smuggling rings.<ref name="TEA" /> [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Abran Balfour/Legends|Abran Balfour's]] [[Sector Group/Legends|Sector Group]] was also known to patrol the Llanic Spice Run from the nearby [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Spice Terminus/Legends|Spice Terminus]].<ref name="SWGG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> Despite the Imperial presence around Llanic, many smugglers simply considered this fact an addition to the planet's intrigue.<ref name="TEA" />
